content.value: Mahim open his law office on July 1, 2020. During the first month of operations, the following (15+20) transactions occurred:
2020, July-1 Mahim invested Tk 300,000 in cash in the law practice.
2020, July-2 Paid Tk 8,000 for July rent on office space in cash.
2020. July-3 Purchased equipment in cash Tk 50,000.
2020. Julv-4 Performed legal services to clients for cash Tk 15,000.
2020.July-6 Performed legal services for client on account Tk 20,000.
2020, July-7 Advertisement bill received but not yet paid Tk 5,000.
2020, July-8 Paid advertisement bill by cheque transaction July-7.
2020, July-9 Purchase supplies on account Tk 7,000.
2020, July-10 Utility bill paid by cheque Tk 2,500.
